While the WebSurfer correctly identified "About A Wife, A Dream And Another..." as a 2013 Russian film, the Planner erroneously stated in its analysis that this film was "produced in the United States." The Planner failed to verify the production country against the retrieved data and instead fabricated a false conclusion to force a "Yes" answer, likely due to an assumption that the titles were similar or a failure to process the "Russian" descriptor correctly.
